input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One layer of a layered 2.5D painted arena plate set for a mage dueling game. FLOOR LAYER ONLY. A painted sunken circular arena floor of packed sand and worn stone slabs seen from a camera about 40 degrees above the ground, filling the whole frame edge to edge. Faint old scorch marks and scuffs, quiet broad surfaces for gameplay. No walls, no sky, no people, no statues, no glowing runes. Mood and palette: night, moonlit blue-black stone, silver highlights, a few warm torches in the balconies. Reference images are for camera, finish and palette only; never copy figures or effects. Tiro, a walled gladiatorial academy where young mages duel in a sunken stone arena; dark enamel and aged silver, restrained verdigris, pale layered cloth, worn metal, warm torchlight against cool magic; each element has its own shape language: fire as forked flames and embers, water as crescents and droplets, air as branching wind and lightning, earth as angular stone and dust. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. No text, watermark, logo, signature, UI mockup clutter, lens dirt, noisy film grain, paper texture, canvas texture, stippling, oversaturated neon, full-body glow, chibi, cartoon mascot, photorealistic modern clothing, guns, sci-fi armour, blurry faces, extra limbs, deformed hands. Aspect 16:9.
